title: Observation persistence holds the state lock for seconds (test_run_observations.rs:1086): full-history projection and inline compaction under StateInner
acceptance: Observation persistence no longer projects full history or compacts inline while holding StateInner. The work under the lock is bounded per batch, and bounded metadata shows the phase and row counts of each persistence step.

A behaviour test with a large observation history shows the lock-held work is bounded by the batch, not by the history size: it fails before the fix, and it uses counts, not wall-clock thresholds. Recorded results are unchanged.
The review pair is clean, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
